name: WatchSync
overview: Sync watch history between copies of the same media (e.g. 4K and HD libraries)
description: Keeps watched state, resume position, play count and last played date in sync between copies of the same movie or episode in different libraries, in both directions. Rebuilt from upstream 2.0.1 against Jellyfin 12.1.

versions.changelog: Upstream 2.0.1 rebuilt against Jellyfin.Controller 12.1.0 (upstream pins 12.4, which a 12.1 server refuses to load). No code changes.
